title: The Rain, 2003
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Sixth January. The espresso machine steaming in the rain. Silent. Warm.

panels.composition: The shack in January rain, the door open, the machine's steam curling out into the wet. GULLY inside at the machine. WOOD and BARNABY under the eave in the chair.

characters.pose: in the chair under the eave

image.prompt: a shingle shack in dense January rain with its door open and espresso steam curling out into the wet air, a young man inside at a chrome machine, another in a lawn chair under the eave with a small dog on his lap, black and white, no words

panels.composition: A small cup handed out the door into the rain.

image.prompt: close-up of a small steaming cup handed out through a doorway into rain, one hand giving, one taking, no words

panels.composition: Wood in the chair with the cup. The dog. The rain. Gully in the doorway with his own.

image.prompt: a young man in a lawn chair under a shack's eave holding a small cup, a dog on his lap, another young man in the doorway with his own cup, rain beyond, no words

panels.composition: Same. Held. The steam and the rain the same shade of nothing.

image.prompt: the same shack eave in rain, two figures with small cups and a dog, steam and rain indistinguishable, black and white, no words
